type-system/nominative-records.md.assessment: XSLT-defined identity and constructors are implemented; standalone XPath declarations and the complete historical moving proposal are not adopted.
type-system/nominative-records.md.alternative: Use supported XSLT record declarations or structural records; identity and structural membership differ.

operators-and-syntax/method-call-operato.assessment: The =?> operator remains refused; mapping-arrow support does not implement method dispatch.
operators-and-syntax/method-call-operato.alternative: Direct map/array functions; array:size packing-plan examples are executable.

experimental/fn-scan.md.assessment: Only XPath40Experimental resolves scan; frozen-gate retry is not frozen API promotion.
experimental/fn-scan.md.alternative: Experimental scan preserves array-wrapped intermediate states; fold-left is an alternative only when the final state is sufficient.

operators-and-syntax/sequence-collection.assessment: Delivered iteration over sequences of containers supersedes this bounded original deferral; member sequence boundaries remain intact.
operators-and-syntax/sequence-collection.alternative: Older-profile for/array/map functions remain alternatives; no portable map order promise.

data-model/jnode-template-boundary.md.assessment: JNode navigation is delivered. Generic node identity/type/pattern and full built-in/template behavior remain outside that delivery.
data-model/jnode-template-boundary.md.alternative: Explicit navigation is supported; generic XML node operations are not equivalent.

rejected/obsolete-quantifier-functions.m.assessment: Bosak never adopted all/some-of registrations; the original dossier records those names as rejected. This does not reconstruct every external draft.
rejected/obsolete-quantifier-functions.m.alternative: Use every/some for predicate quantification and all-equal/all-different for value comparison; these contracts differ.

rejected/directional-scan.md.assessment: scan-left and scan-right remain unavailable, including Experimental.
rejected/directional-scan.md.alternative: Experimental scan is left-fold only; reverse/reverse is not a general right-scan equivalence.

rejected/mapping-arrow-gtgt.md.assessment: Old =>> spelling remains refused; the parser adopted =!> directly.
rejected/mapping-arrow-gtgt.md.alternative: Use =!> at frozen4 or an explicit for expression at older profiles; preserve containing focus and C04 mapping-focus defect.

rejected/xpath-switch-expression.md.assessment: No XPath switch expression is adopted. XSLT switch is a separate instruction with C06 H02 still open.
rejected/xpath-switch-expression.md.alternative: XPath if/then/else is supported; XSLT switch does not establish XPath expression support.

rejected/extensible-map-types.md.assessment: No extensible-map proposal promotion follows from delivered record behavior.
rejected/extensible-map-types.md.alternative: Record cast discards surplus keys; coercion rejects them with XPTY0004. Preserve that distinction and C05 defects.

deferred/xslt-item-type.md.assessment: Historical deferred URL now describes implemented bounded aliases; directory name is not classification.
deferred/xslt-item-type.md.alternative: Use declared aliases in their supported XSLT scope; no standalone XPath declaration facility or full contract certification.

deferred/xslt-record-type.md.assessment: Historical deferred URL now describes implemented bounded named records; identity/default/static contexts retain C03/C05 limits.
deferred/xslt-record-type.md.alternative: Use supported XSLT named records or structural record types with their distinct identity/coercion semantics.

deferred/computed-node-constructors.md.assessment: Computed node constructors remain refused by all four standalone XPath modes. Shared XQuery parser support is host gated.
deferred/computed-node-constructors.md.alternative: Existing XQuery3.1 constructors or portable XSLT node construction; text concatenation/parse-xml is not universal safe construction.

deferred/capturing-accumulators.md.assessment: Accepting capture attributes without snapshot behavior is not implementation. Retained probes observe source-node identity.
deferred/capturing-accumulators.md.alternative: Ordinary accumulators and explicit snapshot/in-memory invoice examples are distinct supported operations; no capture/streaming equivalence.

deferred/enclosing-modes.md.assessment: Nested mode declarations refuse XTSE0260 before draft enclosure semantics.
deferred/enclosing-modes.md.alternative: Top-level named modes with explicit dispatch or #current supply tested alternatives; package/unused-body combinations remain bounded.

deferred/fn-apply-templates.md.assessment: Function calls/lookup refuse; instruction availability does not register the proposed function.
deferred/fn-apply-templates.md.alternative: Use xsl:apply-templates with explicit host state; instructions inside functions are not adoption of fn:apply-templates.

deferred/serialization-parameters.md.assessment: Ignored keys or JSON escaping observed incidentally do not prove new4.0 parameter semantics.
deferred/serialization-parameters.md.alternative: Use existing serialization/portable JSON Lines and the explicitly implemented XSLT solidus flag; no canonicalization promise.

deferred/external-input-functions.md.assessment: Five named external-input proposals remain absent in reviewed registration and execution paths.
deferred/external-input-functions.md.alternative: Use documented preprocessed/local XML/JSON/text input with explicit host policy; none is a universal substitute for HTML/iXML/schema services.

deferred/language-streaming-scope.md.assessment: XQuery3.1 and existing burst/streaming support remain delivered; this is not XQuery4 or full XSLT4 streaming adoption.
deferred/language-streaming-scope.md.alternative: Use existing host APIs and tested bounded transformations; keep language routing and streamability claims separate.
